title: Factory preset content refinement
description:
Refine factory preset JSON content under Resources/Presets/ after phase-K authoring so presets remain categorized, gain-conscious, and load-safe starting points per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §16 and §22 (factory presets are gain-conscious and categorized).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- Resources/Presets/PreAmp_TightSixString.json
- Resources/Presets/Rhythm_ModernCleanup.json
- Resources/Presets/Lead_SingingFocus.json
- Resources/Presets/Bass_ClangControl.json
- Resources/Presets/Diag_FindResonances.json
- Source/ParameterIDs.h (valid parameter key strings and ranges — read only)
- Source/Profiles.h placement/tuning names and indices (read only)
- Source/StateManager.* factory load expectations / schema_version (read only)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §16 Factory Presets and §15 profiles

Refine (do not rename files unless broken; keep the five canonical names):
1. Ensure every preset has schema_version, name, category (Pre-Amp / Rhythm / Lead / Bass / Diagnostic as appropriate), and placement + tuning references consistent with Profiles.
2. Parameter maps use ParameterIDs-style keys only; values in legal ranges (freq 20–20k where applicable, Q positive finite, gains not stacked to combined extreme boosts).
3. Gain-conscious: outputGain / makeup / staged boosts restrained (rough unity intent; avoid simultaneous large positive inputGain + multi-band boosts + outputGain > ~+6 dB without compensating cuts). Prefer mild utility settings over clip-marketing curves.
4. Module enables sensible per category: PreAmp favors Tight Cut restraint; Rhythm mild low-mid cleanup / Chug-friendly defaults; Lead upper-mid polish without harsh +12 dB spikes; Bass clang control without killing fundamental; Diag analyzer/resonance-friendly defaults (not a loud rock preset).
5. JSON remains valid (parseable); keep meta/comment fields noting gain-conscious design if already present.
6. Do not add new preset files beyond the five factory set unless fixing a missing canonical file from k.3. No C++ or CMake edits.
